segments.he: עו"ש (או' רלה) עיקר שלימות השגת הצדיק הוא כשזוכה ע"י השגתו נסתרות שבתורה להמשיך עי"ז עצות ודרכים ונתיבות ותחבולות איך להביא ישראל לידי מעשה ולקיום התורה, כי לא המדרש עיקר אלא המעשה עיי"ש.
segments.en: And see in Likutay Halachos [Hil. Theft 3] which writes that Yosef the Tzaddik received all the seventy aspects of Torah from his father — as it says "the son of old age" — and our Sages said "all that he learned from Shem and Ever he transmitted to him." Therefore he knew how to clothe the Torah in narrative stories — which are the aspect of telling the dreams to his brothers. For in truth even in dreams and stories that people tell — there are also high and hidden things — only people do not know what they are talking about. But the true Tzaddik — the aspect of Yosef — knows and understands the Torah and the truth hidden in them. See there.
